deviations.detail: The generic Remotion renderer has no flow_network model; the reallocation cannot be shown as moving allocations in the templated path.
deviations.proposed_change: Render SC009 in atelier with the CAPITAL_FLOW model (renderer: bespoke) — or, if not approved, replace A02 by a comparison card (would violate REPLACE_CAUSAL_MODEL_WITH_TEXT).
